note: FIFA 21 Team of the Week squads for Squad Battles. 'current' is the one TOTW that can be played; every week can be browsed in the in-game TOTW archive. Starters are EA's TOTW XI, checked against EA's TOTW graphics. Formation: EA picked every FIFA 21 TOTW to a 3-4-3 (31 weeks exactly 3 DEF / 4 MID / 3 ATT by EA's card positions; weeks 3, 7, 9 and 31 have one player across a line). Each starter's 'slot' is his best fit in that 3-4-3. Subs are in EA's order. resourceIds are this server's catalogue ids.
